subject.title: [Bug]: qqbot + ollama + local model: qwen3.5:27b report: error Embedded agent failed before reply: LLM request failed: network connection was interrupted

question: For QQBot runs backed by an explicit Ollama/local model, should OpenClaw keep waiting or retry/fallback when the provider stream is interrupted before `timeoutSeconds`, or should it surface that provider failure immediately as current docs imply?
rationale: The logs and source show timeout-shaped provider failure handling before the configured long timeout, but the safe product behavior depends on whether maintainers want strict explicit-model failure semantics, fallback recovery, or longer channel/provider waiting for local models.

options.title: Require live repro first
options.body: Keep this issue open and ask for maintainer-run or reporter-supplied QQBot + Ollama proof before changing timeout or recovery policy.

options.title: Sponsor retry/fallback semantics
options.body: Define interrupted local-provider streams as retryable/fallback-worthy when the model selection source allows fallback, then implement that narrowly with tests and live proof.

options.title: Document external interruption behavior
options.body: If maintainers decide an early Ollama `ECONNRESET` is outside OpenClaw recovery scope for explicit selections, close after documenting the diagnostic path and evidence that OpenClaw did not abort early.

recommendation.title: Require live repro first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and ask for maintainer-run or reporter-supplied QQBot + Ollama proof before changing timeout or recovery policy.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has recent history on the QQBot timeout resolver and release-state path, making them the best available routing owner for the timeout/recovery policy question.
